Since Four Decades
Mandia Anchalik College was established in 1981 to provide higher education opportunities to the rural youth of the Mandia region. The college began its journey with the Arts stream under the leadership of founding Principal Atatur Rahman. Affiliated with Gauhati University and Bhattadev University, the institution currently offers Undergraduate programs in Arts through eight academic departments. The college is committed to academic excellence, holistic student development, and community-oriented education. It is also preparing for the second cycle of National Assessment and Accreditation ...

Principal's Message
Shahidul Islam
Principal
A college principal is the chief head and administrative leader of a college. They are responsible for managing academic activities, maintaining discipline, supervising teachers and staff, and ensuring the smooth functioning of the institution. A principal also guides students, implements educational policies, and works for the overall development and reputation of the college.
